short: The most decorated US warship of World War II, USS Enterprise fought in almost every major Pacific campaign.
full:
Commissioned in 1938, the Yorktown-class aircraft carrier USS Enterprise became the operational core of the US Navy following the destruction of the battleship fleet at Pearl Harbor. She played a crucial role in the pivotal Battle of Midway, where her dive bombers sank three Japanese carriers. Enterprise went on to participate in the Guadalcanal campaign, the Philippine Sea, and Leyte Gulf.

Nicknamed "The Big E", she survived numerous bomb and kamikaze hits, earning 20 battle stars and a Presidential Unit Citation. At one point in 1942, she was the only operational American carrier in the Pacific. Despite efforts to preserve her as a museum ship after being decommissioned in 1947, she was tragically sold for scrap in 1958.
